name: Three-party flow: Technical Brief
description: Three tall panels joined by two arrows, each a monospace role label over what that party does — a handover, not a list of three teams. Cards without arrows would lose the direction the contract flows in.

kicker.hint: the section name alone in monospace capitals, up to 6 characters; filled automatically from the story chapter, empty when there is none

title.hint: the claim of the slide in one sentence, one line of up to 30 characters; *keyword* turns teal

subtitle.hint: a lede that says why this slide matters, up to 2 lines and 40 characters per line

node-1.hint: a party: a metric whose value is the role in monospace (up to 8 characters), label what they do (up to 12 characters) and delta the detail

caveat.hint: a caveat or a limit, up to 2 lines; amber is reserved for this

meta.hint: footer small print: where this page's facts come from, up to 10 characters; the scaffold fills it from the occasion, so overwrite it per page

title.value: Three kinds of user, so the format must be a contract

subtitle.value: Three roles are held together by one contract and nothing else.

node-1.label: Sets the rules, builds the tool
node-1.delta: Decides what is checked and how, and which run conditions get recorded

node-2.label: Runs it from a config
node-2.delta: Executes on the target machine without needing the domain details

node-3.label: Reads the format only
node-3.delta: Joins tables by string equality on the key, never by judging the check

caveat.value: ⚠️ The viewer must never guess: a key that differs by one character is a different measurement, not a typo.
